memory_precheck.accounting_rule: All simultaneously loaded neural graphs count as active model bytes. A separate router graph cannot be omitted.
memory_precheck.reason: The exact quality-passing artifact deterministically fails the active-memory gate before an expensive headline benchmark. Historical benchmark code counts only runtime.graph_bytes and must be corrected before reuse.

measured_limiting_factor: The FP32 zero-control transformer routing prepass duplicates a full three-block neural stack solely to choose one of ten routes. The English core, task controls, symbolic substrate, checkpoint, and decoding contract already pass and must remain frozen.
next_bounded_experiment: GPU-train one compact 10-way router from search-only labeled English-core prompts, validate it on a disjoint non-final router set, export it as a physically executed small graph, and re-run the unchanged native quality, memory, TTFT, throughput, identity, and sparse-execution gates on the same successor artifact.
